findings.title: 17 entries in .audits/index.json have closing_pr as branch-name string instead of integer 0
findings.detail: The plan.md finding schema specifies closing_pr as an integer GitHub PR number, or 0 for local-only fixes without a PR. 17 findings in index.json use branch-name strings (e.g. 'audit/nightly-2026-07-11') instead. Previous audits fixed this in individual per-run scan files but never cleaned up the index.json rollup. All 17 violations are in entries closed between 2026-07-11 and 2026-08-02; entries from 2026-08-04 onwards correctly use integer 0.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace all string closing_pr values in index.json findings[] with integer 0. The branch name is already implied by the finding ID convention and the closed_at timestamp.
findings.fix_summary: Replaced all 17 string closing_pr values in .audits/index.json findings[] with integer 0; moved branch names into fix_summary where not already present. All violations were in entries closed 2026-07-11 through 2026-08-02.

findings.title: Phase 4 gate overdue day counts stale across 8 locations (77→79 days, 91→93 days elapsed, 2026-08-20→2026-08-22)
findings.detail: Phase 3 soak completed 2026-06-04. As of 2026-08-22: 79 days overdue (was 77 as of 2026-08-20), 93 days elapsed since Phase 3 start on 2026-05-21 (was 91). Stale references appear in README.md (×2), plan.md (×3), docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md (×1), docs/proposer-spec.md (×1), docs/quota-pacing-design.md (×1). Same recurring pattern fixed every nightly audit run.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace '77 days overdue' with '79 days overdue', '91 days elapsed' with '93 days elapsed', and 'as of 2026-08-20' with 'as of 2026-08-22' across all 8 affected locations.
findings.fix_summary: Updated stale day counts in README.md (×2), plan.md (×3), docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md (×1), docs/proposer-spec.md (×1), docs/quota-pacing-design.md (×1): 77→79 days overdue, 91→93 days elapsed, as-of date 2026-08-20→2026-08-22.

findings.title: 3 finding IDs in index.json use descriptive text suffixes instead of 8-char hex format
findings.detail: Three entries in index.json have IDs that don't conform to the AUDIT-<repo>-<hash8> format specified in plan.md: 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-proposer-date-2026-07-13', 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-ifleet-adrs-date-2026-07-13', and 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-day-counts-20260813'. All three are already-fixed entries from nightly runs in July-August 2026. Changing these retroactively would require matching updates to the original scan files and is not worth the risk of cross-reference breakage.
findings.fix_sketch: Cannot safely fix retroactively — changing historical IDs breaks any audit system that references them. Document as known deviation; future scans must use proper 8-char hex IDs. Status: open/unfixable-retroactively.
